name: Kelly Morrison
bio: a Representative from Minnesota; born in Minneapolis, Hennepin County, Minn., February 2, 1969; graduated from The Blake School, Minneapolis, Minn., 1987; B.A., Yale University, New Haven, Conn., 1991; attended Boston University, Boston, Mass.; M.D., Case Western Reserve University, Cleveland, Ohio, 1997; physician; member of the Minnesota state house of representatives, 2019-2023; member of the Minnesota state senate, 2023-2024; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
